topic: Sharks existed 200 million years before the first tree ever grew on Earth
hook: Sharks existed before trees. Let that sink in.
script: Sharks existed before trees. Let that sink in. Sharks have been swimming Earth's oceans for 450 million years. The first trees appeared only 350 million years ago. Sharks predate forests by 100 million years. They survived every mass extinction. They watched the dinosaurs come and go. They are older than the Amazon rainforest. Follow for evolution facts that make humans feel very new.
